title: Alley meetings and Big Eye Louis Nelson's late nights and cooking
summary: Musicians met in the alley to play poker and piano until sunrise; Big Eye Louis stayed out until 7 a.m., shopped at the market and cooked his own breakfast.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Cabarets, honky-tonks and the Storyville nightlife scene
